action_definition: One action = one bounded recovery attempt: a single rg/grep invocation, one file read, one gh search/fetch, or one convmem search/ask call. Agent chooses queries; harness does not.
c0_definition: Fresh Agent B per question; ConvMem disabled; ordinary filesystem rg/read, gh, and transcript directories available.
c1_definition: Fresh Agent B per question; identical ordinary environment plus frozen ConvMem (search/ask). CONVMEM_CONFIG points at rerun c1-frozen snapshot.
symmetry_requirement: C0 and C1 tool manifests differ only by ConvMem tools; verified before each condition run.
artifact_policy: Natural Agent-A transcripts available; experiment-created answer-bearing markdown and inter-model handoffs excluded from C0 roots.
corpus_freeze_method: rsync pre-C0 chroma snapshot; multi-field marker in frozen/marker.json
scoring_rules: Executor records outcomes; authoritative verdict only after independent review. P@1/MRR omitted if evaluator identity contract cannot match document-derived units.

questions.text: What is the rent budget ceiling for the Portland move?
How much can we afford for housing there each month?
What did we think about that one neighborhood?
Given the must-haves, what kind of place should we look for?
What's the current decision on which Portland neighborhood to prioritize?
Which option did we rule out and why?
What's still open / undecided about the move?
Is there anything relevant we filed elsewhere?
